**Issue #4604 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4604: CI: super run failed on a production candidate
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 45148807390](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45148807390) on #4600, the promotion of `44439387fb6a` into production, failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [fuzz (2/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45148807390/job/137608354347) | failure |
| [fuzz (4/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45148807390/job/137608354355) | failure |
| [fuzz (1/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45148807390/job/137608354469) | failure |
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45148807390/job/137608354526) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: production waits on this run, so it is yours and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item). #4600 promotes `44439387fb6a`, a commit of `_staging` (and so of `main`), so the fix lands on `main` like any other. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). Say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them. Once the fix is on `main`, promote-staging.yml brings it to `_staging` within two hours; the next daily run there that passes promotes it, or a `/promote` on the production issue tests staging's newer commit sooner.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```

## Goal

Every job of super run 45148807390 — `fuzz (1/4)` to `fuzz (4/4)` — passes again: each shard's plain wave (3,125 seeds), handicapped wave and Duos wave (500 seeds). The planner replayed shards 1–4's Duos waves and shards 1–2's plain waves on `84e1400b22` (which holds the promoted `44439387fb`). Every failure is the new invariant **I21** ("I21 Spell reached Immune to Spells", #4508, `b567407a24`, merged 2026-11-23 07:04). About 1 seed in 300 trips it, so the pull request's 200 seeds passed by luck. Root cause: I21 found three real engine bugs, where a Spell's effect reaches a Unit Immune to Spells through another card's rule, plus six readings where the monitor blames the game's own rules on the Spell.
